title: Every Anime Coming to Netflix in September 2026
content: As the Summer 2026 anime season continues, Netflix is releasing a new list of anime series and films for its September Calendar. Unlike Crunchyroll, which releases dozens of seasonal releases, Netflix has a monthly schedule for the latest series and the older series getting licensed for the first time.
author: ComicBook

title: My Happy Marriage Anime Special Airs on October 25 With All 3 Episodes
content: Kadokawa revealed on Monday all three episodes of the anime special for the television anime based on Akumi Agitogi and Tsukiho Tsukioka 's My Happy Marriage ( Watashi no Shiawase na Kekkon ) light novel series will air and stream on October 25.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Wakako-zake Series Gets 10th Season Partly Set in Australia
content: BS TV Tokyo announced on Monday that the live-action series based on Chie Shinkyū 's Wakako-zake manga will receive a 10th season that will premiere on the BS TV Tokyo channel in January 2027. Rina Takeda will again star in the series.
author: ANN

title: Critically Acclaimed Shonen Jump Creators Break Silence on Return After 6 Years
content: Ever since it was launched in 1968, Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine has serialized some of the most iconic series of all time, including Dragon Ball, One Piece, Naruto , and more. Thanks to all these exceptional series, WSJ eventually became the highest-selling manga magazine of all time.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Hottest New Shonen Anime of 2026 Enters Its Endgame As Its Hero Seeks Perfection
content: The release of new shonen anime every season has become a trend in the anime industry, and this year has seen plenty of great shonen releases. However, one of the newest shonen entries of 2026 comes from Summer 2026 on Crunchyroll, with Black Torch , based on a manga that came to a premature end almost a decade ago.
author: ComicBook

title: Bleach Creator Breaks Silence on The Biggest Challenge in Anime’s Final Season
content: More than 22 years since the original anime’s premiere, Bleach is all set for its finale, and it’s way better than fans expected. The original anime premiered in 2004 and stopped airing in 2012, leaving fans waiting for the final season for a decade.
author: ComicBook

title: Kono Oto Tomare! Manga to End in 3 Chapters
content: Amyū announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Sunday the Kono Oto Tomare!: Sounds of Life manga will end in three chapters, including the new chapter in the issue of Shueisha 's Jump SQ. magazine that will ship on September 4.
author: ANN

title: Bleach Fully Explains How Orihime’s Brand-New Power Up Actually Works
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War truly shocked Bleach fans by giving Orihime Inoue a major power up in the final season, and the newest episode has helped to explain how her reality bending power actually worked.

title: Dandadan Creator Returns With New Look At Beloved Characters Ahead of Season 3
content: Dandadan Season 3 is still a while away, and it’s going to adapt the manga’s best arc. Written and illustrated by Yukinobu Tatsu, the beloved Shonen Jump+ manga released its anime adaptation in Fall 2024. The anime returned with a new season in Summer 2025, six months after the first season’s finale.
